teacher_info.intro:
Hello :)
My mother tongue is Armenian, my second language is English, my third language is Spanish, next one is Russian, the other one is French...okok lets stop for a while.
Teaching exposes me to a world of different nations, cultures and the greatest diversity of personalities. I love teaching because sharing my knowledge with others is very rewarding.
Nowadays learning a language is no longer seen as being learnt through mechanical exercises, it's developed through students interacting and engaging and how said Federico Fellini " A different language is a different vision of life".
Let's discover languages together :)
See you!
teacher_info.short_signature: The certified and cool teacher from the  extraordinary Galaxy. Nice to meet you
teacher_info.introduction: A different language is a different vision of life (Federico Fellini).I really like languages since my childhood. I both like teaching and learning languages.Now I am currently learning Italian. Short about me. I am a person with multiple interests and have always been thinking of making a career, becoming a successful person and generally finding my way in the mad mad mad mad world.So I would like to use my gained knowledge and experience in order to teach and be helpful to everyone.Besides languages, I love reading, music, cinema, sports(I like such kind of sports that upgrade strength, reaction and flexibility; for ex. tennis, swimming and chess).Cinema is my passion. Every year I do not miss the opportunity to be part of Golden Apricot International Film Festival. In that way, I have met lots of directors, actors and actresses such as: Wim Wenders, Nastassja Kinski, Kim Ki-duk, Ornella Muty, Sergey Solovyev, Roman Balayan, Atom Egoyan, Hugh Hudson and many others). Short but interesting information about my native language. Armenian language forms a separate branch of Indo-European language family. It also has its own and unique alphabet. The Armenian language is one of the oldest languages in the world.It may seem a bit difficult but if there is interest you can overcome all difficulties with pleasure., because everything is possible. :) Conclusion: Some words about my lesson plan. If you are good at teaching unplanned lessons, you will be better teaching with a productive plan. So lesson plan plays its important role in teaching. Without each other the process can not be complete and productive. Making an effective lesson plan takes time, diligence and understanding of students' goals and abilities. The goal as with all teaching is to motivate the students to take what you are teaching and retain as much as possible. Let's learn languages together and at the same time discover lots of interesting things. Feel free to contact me and join my classes! See you!

teacher_info.about_teacher: More than one person has told me that becoming an English teacher was a bad career choice. However, my decision to become an English teacher was not based on the job marque, but on where I think I best fit in the grand scheme of things. If language is at the heart of everything we do, then I want to be in the middle of the action, helping others learn to use language well.We need to analyze and evaluate the information using strategic and extended thinking; this leads to creating a point of view on a topic. My goal as a teacher is to ensure my students have the skills they’ll need to make informed and logical decisions that benefit themselves and their community.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Great teachers are nimble, observant, and responsive, always keeping an open mind about how to best engage their students and get them excited about learning—and that means considering trying out different interactive teaching styles.
My methods include these characteristics:
Encourage student participation.
Use questions that stimulate response, discussion, and a hands-on experience.
Use teaching aids that press for answers, and capture/hold the student’s attention.
Set up a work group environment.
Involve yourself as well as the student.

pro_course_detail.title: The Proust Questionnaire or "Get to know me"
pro_course_detail.description:
The Proust Questionnaire has its origins in a parlor game popularized (though not devised) by Marcel Proust, the French essayist and novelist, who believed that, in answering these questions, an individual reveals his or her true nature.
So here you will be asked questions in Russian, and be corrected on your mistakes, working on grammar and Syntax.
Lessons will be intellectually planned and students will have very useful feedbacks.
No time to get bored during a class.
See you!

This lesson is designed for beginners who want to learn or consolidate their basic Portuguese knowledge. It will build a foundation that will allow you to easily progress on your learning journey. The lesson covers all basic and important Portuguese concepts such as greetings, alphabet, sounds, colours, numbers, days of the week, monthsof the year, most commonused sentences and much more.

My lesson is very interactive, fun and full of games and activities. I am very open, flexible, patient and I like to understand my students to help them improve. I'm sure you will enjoy learning with me. See you on class!

Each lesson will have an interesting topic selected by me or you. We will have a fun and interactive discussion about it. This is the best way to practice your speaking, listening, build vocabulary and most important gain confidence to speak naturally.

My lessons are interactive and fun. I'm friendly, patient and understandable. Don't wait more book the lesson and see you on class!

course_info.trial_description:
💁🏻🧏🏿‍♂️ In our first lesson, we get to know each other. I want to learn where you're from, what you do, your experience with languages, and especially your goals.

📋 In principle, all my lessons have a basic structure:
1) Intro,
2) Content, and
3) Conclusion.

Regardless of the type of lesson, we usually do some warm-up activities, we recap what we did in previous lessons (or during the whole package), and we continue with more content. Finally, we'll always devote the last 5 or 10 minutes to writing a record and assigning you homework.

💡 Suggestions are ESPECIALLY welcome! Please don't forget about this. This is YOUR space to learn, and your ideas matter.

🔎 I pay attention to all aspects of your performance, especially speaking, vocabulary, and grammar.

Last but not least...
❤️ Thank you for reading and considering me!

pro_course_detail.title: 📈 Improve your GENERAL Spanish from A0 to C2! / Melhore o seu espanhol geral de A0 a C2! / ¡Mejorá tu español general de A0 a C2! 📈
pro_course_detail.description:
The goal of this lesson is to find the limits of your knowledge to teach you more.

This is the average structure of this lesson:
PART 1: ROUTINE. We start with a set of basic tasks like saying the date, the time, the weather, talking about the last few days and your plans for the weekend, playing a game, etc., all to warm up and to assure you practice on essential topics. The actual tasks will vary depending on what you need. Also to keep things interesting. Depending on your proficiency with these tasks, we can spend 3 to 20 minutes, but if that's the case, don't worry! Precisely, our goal is that, eventually, you'll get the hang of it and do the routine in no time.
PART 2: RECAP + CONTENT. Next, we remember what you did in previous lessons (or during the whole package), and we continue with more content.
PART 3: RECORD + HOMEWORK. Finally, we write a record for the lesson, and we decide on homework. In principle, we'll do this 10 minutes before the lesson ends so you get used to this, too, just like the routine.

Or, in a more colorful way:
[[[To start.]]]
What's the date today? 📅
What time is it? ⏰
What's the weather like in your location? ☀️
Let's order ☕️.
Let's buy food 🥗🛒.
The past ⬅️.
The future ➡️.
Game 🎲.
[[[To continue.]]]
- Recap >🧮.
- Content 🧮<.
[[[To finish.]]]
- Record 📝.
- Homework 📓.

📑 This lesson is based on Spanish for General Purposes (to talk to friends and relatives, to travel, to enjoy movies, etc.), but we can also learn Spanish gradually for Specific Purposes (to work, to attend higher education classes or vocational training, etc.).
🔎 Listening and speaking are what I focus on by default, but we can also work on reading and writing.
🧉 I teach River Plate Spanish, spoken in and around Buenos Aires, Argentina. However, I use and recommend materials from other teachers, not only because they're great and useful (and they put in the work to make them for us), but also for you to get used to different accents and backgrounds.

I’m a Spanish tutor with over eight years of experience, teaching both online and in-person. My passion for languages goes beyond teaching—I love helping students connect with people, explore new perspectives, and experience life through language.
With a background in biomedical engineering and a specialization in the neuroscience of language development, I understand how the brain acquires language. This allows me to create effective, science-backed learning strategies that help students learn naturally and retain knowledge better.
I have also studied Spanish grammar and the history of the language in depth, which allows me to explain its structure clearly and relate it to other languages.
teacher_info.short_signature: This is my Passion, I'm excited to share it with you and help you Excel!

teacher_info.about_teacher:
He estado enseñando idiomas desde el 2017 con excelentes resultados. Mis estudiantes pueden ver progreso en su nivel de comunicación muy rapidamente. Además mis clases son divertidas porque hablamos de muchas cosas diferentes de una forma muy relajada.

I´ve been teaching languages since 2017 with excellent results. My students can notice progress on their comunication level very quickly. My classes are also fun because we talk about many different things in a very relaxed way.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Creo que la mejor manera de aprender es combinando la estrategia de adquisicion de un idioma que usa un bebé con las ventajas que tenemos los adultos para organizarnos y optimizar el aprendizaje con técnicas probadas. Mi método es preciso, cómodo y efectivo.

I believe that the best way of learning is to combine the language acquisition strategy used by babies with the advantages we have as adults to organize and optimize the learning process with proven techniques. In my classes you don't have to memorize word lists or verb's conjugations. My method is precise, comfortable and effective.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish: From Beginner to Bilingual
pro_course_detail.description: Hola, soy Nak! In these classes you will learn how to think and communicate in Spanish in record time. My method is entirely focused on efficiency and my goal is to get you conversational very quickly, so then you will recommend me to your friends, because you will notice your own progress! This is a team, the best student won't progress with a bad teacher, and the best teacher won't succeed with a student who doesn't have a real interest for learning. So let's be the best team ever and we will both win: you will learn Spanish in record time and that will give me a good review!!! Comencemos! :D

Can't wait to talk with you!

 ◽️ Short-form adjectives
...

also

- Cultural Insights

Entrepreneurs, software engineers, CEOs, college teachers, college/university students, ballet dancers ...
I've taught people from all over the world. I've taught students of different ages starting from 5 to 60+.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My main emphasis is daily spoken language. So I don't use old fancy materials like old fairy tales from 19th or 18th century. Although we could, of course, if you want.

I'm a big supporter of comprehensive approach. So I think you need grammar, vocabulary, speaking, and listening at the same time but I tend to concentrate more on daily spoken language.

I use whole bunch of different materials. I use textbooks, videos... Sometimes we even sing songs to improve your pronunciation and  vocabulary.


Thanks again, and I look forward to hearing from you soon. :-)
